relationships.subject: proBDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: proBDNF activates the low-affinity p75 pan neurotrophin receptor (p75NTR) rather than trkB

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: strong activity matching strong depolarization, as well as mature BDNF binding to trkB, triggers LTP and the subsequent activation of calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII), AMPAR phosphorylation, and exocytosis

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: it can alter the balance between excitation and inhibition by inhibiting the GABAergic neurons

key_findings: Mature BDNF/trkB induces LTP with CaMKII activation while proBDNF/p75NTR sustains LTD.
BDNF is expressed in CGRP+ and TRPV1+ peptidergic DRG nociceptors and rises in DRG after CFA, CCI and SNL.
